reviewer: Codex subagent tree_review, independent of implementation authors
verdict: No inter-workgroup race found in reviewed new kernels for valid registered bindings. Invalid-input sticky failure can suppress unrelated work, but uses device-scope atomic accesses; failed-output bytes are not generally a valid-output guarantee.
stage_order: Every staged simple/ng2 submission depends_on the preceding returned event. submit_chain propagates last event across sites. Device::compute also includes the owner preceding event, ordering reuse of shared scratch. Parameter tables are immutable, content-addressed per owner and retained until teardown.

unique_writers.norm: Stage0 writes one row/chunk partial per item. Stage1 writes unique nonoverlapping groups of up to4 output elements; upper partials read-only.
unique_writers.gdn: Stage0 Q/K slices use disjoint32-element ranges and gate scalars occupy disjoint4096..4191 positions. Stage1 item(h,j) exclusively owns state[(h*128+j)*128 .. +127] and one output per token; all sequential reads/writes of that row remain in its owner.
unique_writers.select: Stage0 initializes one selection slot and at most one score per item. Stage1 stable finite rank is injective; four-element blocks selected by distinct ranks never overlap. Trailing positions begin at count*4 and are written solely by b=0.
unique_writers.attention: Scores are one(head,slot) per item. Maxima and sums are one(head,chunk) each; exp chunks and normalized four-element slices are disjoint. Value partials are one(output,chunk); final outputs one per item.
unique_writers.route: Maxima/sums each one chunk; exponentials only within that chunk; probabilities each one index. Finite total rank is unique, so route IDs/probabilities/triples have single writers. Final normalization is one work item after rank event.
unique_writers.argmax_gather_combine: Argmax chunk state is disjoint, final winner single writer. Gather validity/triples indexed uniquely and copy output indexed uniquely; delayed error is one item. Combine/broadcast output index is unique.
unique_writers.prepare: Stage0 one(row,chunk) partial; stage1 unique four-element output slice. Recomputed normalized low/high rotary inputs are read-only; input/output buffers distinct in registered schedule.
unique_writers.pool: Stage0 append items uniquely own current cache elements at rows>=pos, while subtree items read cache only at rows<pos and current rows from input slot2. Thus simultaneous append and subtree reads are disjoint. Stage1 output blocks/four-element slices are unique, after dependent stage0; recomputation again reads historical cache or original current input.

alias_limits: Reviewed actual registered aliases include GDN input/output state and conv history, plus sequential chain outputs consumed by later sites. New norm stages tolerate corresponding elementwise in-place input/output but do not establish arbitrary cross-slot alias safety. No approval for arbitrary malformed alias bindings is implied.
host_order_addendum: Latest adapter host path replaces sequential item loop with mock_items: iota0..n-1 then deterministic shuffle, each item visited exactly once; stage order unchanged. No new arithmetic or device scheduling changes.
